meta.title: Moyosore Baiye | Senior DevSecOps Engineer, Certified DPO and DevOps Educator
meta.description: Moyosore Baiye is a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, Certified Data Protection Officer and DevOps educator based in Lagos, Nigeria, working remotely worldwide on AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and HIPAA, GDPR and NDPR compliance.

hero.title: I keep regulated cloud platforms secure, compliant and running.
hero.lead: I have spent 6+ years building and securing cloud platforms for healthcare and the public sector. Today I lead DevOps and data protection at Octosoft Technologies, build commercial products from the ground up, and teach engineers what production really demands.

focus.title: Four disciplines, one job: systems people can trust.

items.title: DevSecOps
items.text: Security built into delivery: vulnerability scanning in CI/CD, least-privilege IAM, secrets management and threat modeling.

items.title: Data protection
items.text: Certified DPO work for healthcare platforms: impact assessments (DPIAs), privacy by design, and alignment with HIPAA, GDPR and Nigeria's NDPR.

items.title: Cloud and platform engineering
items.text: Multi-AZ AWS and Azure architecture, reusable Terraform modules, Kubernetes, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.

items.title: Education
items.text: Hands-on training in Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and CI/CD, plus mentoring for engineers moving into cloud and platform roles.

experience.title: Where I have done the work

items.role: DevOps Team Lead and Certified Data Protection Officer

bullets.label: Cloud and security leadership
bullets.text: Lead the team that architects, automates and maintains HIPAA-aligned AWS infrastructure for healthcare software used by clinics and patients nationwide.

bullets.label: Data protection
bullets.text: Lead DPIAs, own privacy policy, secure protected health information and enforce NDPR and HIPAA controls end to end.

bullets.label: Infrastructure as code
bullets.text: Built reusable Terraform modules and CloudFormation templates for multi-tenant environments, cutting provisioning from days to under 30 minutes.

bullets.label: CI/CD
bullets.text: Standardized GitHub Actions pipelines with Trivy and Snyk scanning, automated tests and zero-downtime releases.

bullets.label: Observability
bullets.text: Built central monitoring on CloudWatch, Prometheus and Grafana, reaching 99.99% uptime and reducing mean time to detect by 60%.

bullets.label: Culture
bullets.text: Run hands-on workshops and mentor engineers and interns on cloud security, CI/CD and containers.
Ran end-to-end IT infrastructure and citizen-facing digital platforms at 99.9% uptime across agency operations.
Improved system throughput and response times by 50% through query optimization, caching and network tuning.
Enforced government data protection rules with role-based access control, network segmentation and automated backups.
Configured high-availability multi-AZ AWS topologies with load balancers and Auto Scaling groups.
Automated provisioning and configuration baselines with Ansible, Docker and Jenkins.
Set up CloudWatch alarms and fine-grained IAM policies for compute and serverless resources.
Built standardized Docker images and supported Jenkins deployment pipelines.
Configured Linux environments and core identity services, including DNS, LDAP and SSH key management.

teaching.title: I help engineers get ready for production.
teaching.lead: Cloud engineering skills should be within reach wherever you start from. My teaching is practical: real scenarios, real tools, and honest career advice.

items.title: Curriculum and workshops
items.text: Hands-on programs covering zero-downtime CI/CD, Kubernetes, Terraform and Linux hardening.

items.title: Mentoring
items.text: One-to-one guidance for junior engineers, sysadmins and developers moving into DevOps, including CV reviews, mock interviews and portfolio projects.

items.title: Team culture
items.text: Training product and engineering teams on automated testing, shift-left security and shared responsibility for reliability.
